claims.object_text: repressor of the mTORC1 signaling pathway
claims.quote: DEPDC5 (DEP domain-containing protein 5) encodes a repressor of the mTORC1 signaling pathway.
Variants in DEPDC5 are associated with a range of focal epilepsies,
including mosaic variants associated with focal cortical dysplasia (FCD) and other focal brain malformations
The resulting mosaic depdc5 CRISPants demonstrated early larval death, with ~50% of CRISPants (vs. 10% of controls) dead by 7 days post fertilization (dpf),
Body and head size were reduced in the depdc5 CRISPants.

claims.object_text: reduced distance traveled and maximum velocity
claims.quote: Analysis of swimming behavior showed a striking reduction in distance traveled and maximum velocity in the depdc5 CRISPants vs. controls.

claims.object_text: increased episodes of posture loss in depdc5++ CRISPants
claims.quote: depdc5++ CRISPants had increased episodes of posture loss,

claims.object_text: increased seizure-like behavior related to higher percentages of mutant cells
claims.quote: suggesting increased seizure-like behavior related to higher percentages of mutant cells.
Local field potential recordings revealed increased neuronal hyperexcitability in depdc5 CRISPants vs. controls.
Acridine orange staining demonstrated early apoptosis in the CRISPants vs. controls.
